season.evidence: Peakbagger successful ascents: Jun 2, Jul 7, Aug 19, Sep 9, Oct 2, Nov 1. Web search: park trail page says Appleton Pass trail is usually snow-free early July through October with snow possible any season; a May 2024 trip found snow from ~4200 ft. Stored late Jun-Sep kept.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 22 Jun 2026 via Boulder Lake, Three Horse, Blue and Mud lakes then the snow/scree cirque north of the peak; not the Appleton Pass ridge line.
7 Sep 2025 multi-day loop from Aurora Ridge; not a trailhead round trip on our line.
16 Aug 2026, summited but starts partway up (4032 ft), not at a trailhead pin, highest point 610 m from our summit pin, no report text to identify the line.

facts.text: Late in the season, from the pass, cutting across the lower slopes straight toward the main summit is quicker than following the climbers path over the south sub-peak first.

notes: No harvested track follows the stored Sol Duc / Appleton Pass line as a round trip. Trailhead pin untouched.
